text: Implemented typed ReducedRankGls rank policies for fixed, energy-retained, and residual RSS-budget modes. ReducedRankGlsConfig now uses a dedicated ReducedRankComponentSpec ADT with validated EnergyRetained and ResidualSumsOfSquaresBudget constructors; the shared GLS compressed path resolves adaptive ranks from the prepared task score singular spectrum. Added model validation coverage, fmrireg-style adaptive-rank parity against the rank-one partitioned fixture, and chunked RRG coverage using the RRG-specific rank type. Updated fit README to document the typed rank_mode surface. Evidence: sbt modelJVM/test passed 16/16; sbt fitJVM/test passed 127/127; sbt modelJS/test passed 16/16; sbt fitJS/test passed 122/122; git diff --check clean on touched paths; trailing-whitespace scan clean. Remaining: bootstrap/task-only inference result policy and voxelwise-AR compressed RRG.
